title: A DVR after adjoining a positive-order root of a uniformizer
statement: Let B be a commutative DVR domain [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], pi an irreducible uniformizer and n>0. Set A=B[T]/(T^n-pi), and let t be the class of T. Then A is a domain and a DVR, and its maximal ideal is (t). This includes n=1 and imposes no residue-characteristic restriction.

source.place: Tag 09EV, root-algebra argument, with Tag 00PD; Eisenstein irreducibility gives domainhood directly for all n>0.

proof.text: The monic polynomial f=X^n-pi is Eisenstein at (pi). All coefficients below n vanish except the constant -pi. If pi^2 divided pi, cancellation would make pi a unit. Thus Mathlib IsEisensteinAt.irreducible makes f irreducible and prime, and AdjoinRoot.isDomain_of_prime makes A a domain. Monicity makes A finite over B, hence Noetherian.

The root equation is t^n=pi. Construct phi:A -> B/(pi) by evaluation at t=0; constants show it is surjective. Set J=(t), theta:A -> A/J, and construct psi:B/(pi) -> A/J from the constants, since theta(pi)=theta(t)^n=0. Check psi composed with phi equals theta on constants and t using AdjoinRoot.ringHom_ext. Hence ker(phi)=J. Because B/(pi) is a field and phi is surjective, J is maximal.

Every maximal ideal M of A contracts to the maximal ideal (pi) of B, by integrality. Thus pi=t^n lies in M and primality gives t in M. Maximality of J forces M=J. This proves A is local with maximal ideal J. Injectivity of B -> A and pi != 0 show t != 0.

Apply the local principal maximal ideal criterion to the Noetherian local domain A, using t != 0 and m_A=(t), obtaining its DVR structure. Return the domain structure, DVR structure and maximal-ideal equality.

lean.statement:
theorem dvr_uniformizer_root_algebra
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (pi : B) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ n - Polynomial.C pi)
    ∃ (_ : IsDomain A) (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing A),
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A = Ideal.span
        {AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ n - Polynomial.C pi)}
